request.title: Build version 1 now, or freeze and run cheap experiments first?
request.why: Starting a new project competes with the owner's sales focus; only they can make that trade.

options.label: Build a narrow self-use version, cap 2 hours/week

request.rec_reason: The owner's own pain is measurable now, and agent build cost is low.

response.conditions: Review on day 30 with three numbers; if all three are weak, shrink it to a personal tool.

ack.note: Started; the three review numbers are tracked in the weekly digest.
